text: それを　つかうと　もういちど　しょうぶ　したい　トレーナーが　みつかるの！

structure.jp: もういちど　しょうぶ　したい　トレーナーが
structure.en: Trainers who want to battle once more

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing follows. つかうと = 'when you use it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: しょうぶ　したい　トレーナー
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing or person tells you which one is meant. しょうぶしたいトレーナー = 'Trainers who want to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb says someone wants to do it. したい = 'want to do'.
